name: Being Like Christ
overview: Scripture calls believers to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding, recognizing Jesus as both Master and Lord. Loving Christ is demonstrated through obedience to His commandments, and those baptized into Him are called to 'put on Christ,' reflecting a transformation that involves rejecting the old, corrupt ways. Ultimately, God predestines His people to be conformed to the image of His Son, emphasizing that being like Christ is the divine purpose and goal for every believer.
